# Winters Code

> Custom websites and apps for Oregon coast small businesses, built in Bandon, Oregon. Astro, React, and Flutter on a modern stack, with no templates and no WordPress. One person designs, builds, deploys, and maintains every project. Help is just a text away.

Winters Code is the software shop of Preston Winters in Bandon, Oregon. It builds custom marketing websites, web apps, and mobile apps for small businesses in Coos County, Curry County, and along the Oregon coast. Every build runs on a modern stack (Astro, React, Flutter, Supabase, Cloudflare). Local business sites start at $1,750 with everything included, and site builds start at three business days. Rebuilds of an existing site usually run $2,500 to $3,500. Care plans are optional: Basic from $75 per month and Pro from $250 per month.

Contact: Preston Winters. Text or call (541) 551-0731. Email preston@winterscode.com. Based in Bandon, Oregon. Service area: Bandon, Coos Bay, North Bend, Coquille, Myrtle Point, Port Orford, and Gold Beach in Coos and Curry counties, plus Reedsport.

## Services
- [Web Design](https://winterscode.com/services/web-design): Custom marketing websites for small businesses.
- [Web Development](https://winterscode.com/services/web-development): Web apps and custom site builds.
- [App Development](https://winterscode.com/services/app-development): iOS and Android apps in Flutter.
- [Custom Software](https://winterscode.com/services/custom-software): Tools built for a specific business need.
- [AI Automation](https://winterscode.com/services/ai-automation): AI workflows for small teams.
- [SEO and Performance](https://winterscode.com/services/seo-performance): Speed and search work, measured before and after.
- [Core Web Vitals Fix](https://winterscode.com/core-web-vitals-fix): Repairs for slow sites.
- [Website Redesign](https://winterscode.com/website-redesign): Rebuilds of dated or slow sites.
- [Website Maintenance](https://winterscode.com/website-maintenance): Care plans, Basic from $75/mo and Pro from $250/mo.
- [Logo Design](https://winterscode.com/logo-design): Brand marks and identity.
